decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am to 11pm Monday to Saturday and 8am to 10pm on Sunday and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at the site and, other than delivery of prepared meals to customers, no deliveries shall be despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am-5.30pm Monday to Friday, 8 am-5.30 pm on Saturdays nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.

Condition : 6 - A bacterial or enzyme dosing unit shall be fitted on all waste discharge points from kitchen sinks and floor drains prior to discharging to the public sewerage system and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order

Condition : 7 - Before the use hereby approved begins, a fat trap shall be installed and permanently maintained in working order for the duration of the use and an agreement shall be in place with a contractor for the disposal of fats, oils and grease, particularly to recycle for the production of bio-diesel.  These arrangements shall be permanently operated and retained.

Condition : 8 - The use shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins or enclosed refuse bins of similar capacity has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling and not disposed to landfill on a regular basis.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated storage bins within the designated area.  The lids of the bins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 9 - At the time the use hereby permitted first commences, the back door to the premises shall be fitted with a self-closer to be kept permanently in working order and the door shall be kept permanently shut when the kitchen is in operation, except for access purposes and any rear window shall be kept permanently shut.

Condition : 10 - The use shall not commence until a scheme to minimise the effect of noise generated by the use on the occupiers of the residential accommodation adjoining the premises, including soundproofing of the ceiling and (as necessary) walls of the premises has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved scheme shall be implemented as approved before the use commences and shall be retained, as approved, thereafter

Condition : 11 - Before the approved use commences, the new shopfront shall incorporate a level threshold from the pavement to the interior, with a minimum clear door opening area of 900 mm, the door shall have a kicking plate no less than 400 mm high, a coloured frame to distinguish it from the glazing and a mid-height handle across the doorway or some other form of visual manifestation to identify it to people with impaired vision; and the disabled persons' WC shall be installed and made available to customers and these shall be permanently retained.
description: Change of use to Restaurant (A3) and Take Away (A5) incorporating new window to rear at ground floor and extraction ducting.
